title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — Subscription Billing
content:
**Terms.** A store plan of **Selling Plans** is billed its subscription fee once per billing period on the bill day, at the monthly term fee on the monthly term and the annual term monthly fee on the annual term; the Individual Seller Plan has no subscription fee. An annual term renews for another term at term end when annual auto-renew is true, unless a cancellation is scheduled. A plan in cancellation scheduled is still billed for every period that starts before the cancellation effective date. A restricted plan continues to be billed. Subscription fees are collected by deduction from the seller's payments balance.

## Which fee figure each plan is billed at

| Plan | Held on the monthly term | Held on the annual term |
|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |
| Starter Store | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |
| Basic Store | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |
| Premium Store | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |
| Anchor Store | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |
| Enterprise Store | The plan's monthly term fee | The plan's annual term monthly fee |

The figures themselves are those of each plan's subscription schedule. The Individual Seller Plan has no subscription fee, and the Enterprise Store is offered on the annual term only.

## What a subscription fee record shows

Each subscription fee is recorded once per billing period per charge type, with the date billed, the amount, the billing period it covers (the month the period starts), the term it was billed on, and its charge type: a **regular** charge for a billing period, or an **upgrade proration** charge for the rest of a period after a move to a higher plan.

## Billing decisions on hypothetical dates

| Situation (hypothetical) | Billed? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly-term store with a cancellation scheduled to take effect on 10 June; period starting 10 May | Yes | The period starts before the cancellation effective date |
| Same plan; period that would start on 10 June | No | The period does not start before the effective date |
| Store restricted for past-due fees; next period starts | Yes | A restricted plan continues to be billed |
| Annual-term store reaching its term end with auto-renew true and no cancellation scheduled | Renews for another term | Annual auto-renew is true and no cancellation is scheduled |
| Annual-term store reaching its term end with a cancellation scheduled | Does not renew | A scheduled cancellation stops the renewal |
